Hylt ane PNG-geþryccede ICO-anlicnesse æt þære gecorenan micelnesse (16–256 anlicnesprican). Þin anlicnes hylt hire mæðe betweox bræde and heahþe and biþ gesett on middan feowerscytes hiwes þe man þurh gesihþ.
Hylt PNG butan lyre swa Base64-gewrit, þe onginþ mid «data:image/png;base64,». Opena þis gewrit eft þæt þu þa anlicnesse eft staþelie. Base64-gewrit is mare þonne þæt PNG þe hit hæfþ.
Hylt anne RGB-tramet. Geþryccung mæg gewrites micelnesse læssian butan anlicnespricena awendinge; forbeod hie for TIFF butan geþryccunge.
